scope: Vibhu optimizer only; no LLM/API/UI evaluation is claimed.
assumptions: Duty and capacity_loss_pct are fractions: 0.30 means 30%, matching the existing loader.
One plant per order; all orders available at planning start; production may span days.
Shared plant capacity distributed equally across working days and rounded down.
Duty applies to production plus energy; transport uses calendar days.
Prices and weekly overrides are explicit configuration, not inferred from CSV.
Overlapping events use the largest active loss; early inventory has no holding cost.
Equal order priority; no execution/WIP state is supplied.
warnings: Plant A shared capacity explicitly configured as 850 units/week; CSV row values=[850, 865].
Plant B shared capacity explicitly configured as 760 units/week; CSV row values=[760, 775].
Plant C shared capacity explicitly configured as 640 units/week; CSV row values=[640, 655].

latency.method: Repeated in-process full solve+result-check calls; ingestion excluded.
latency.limitation: Small local sample; not a production latency guarantee.
